name: spa_search
description: Search CMS Medicaid.gov Medicaid State Plan Amendments (SPAs) by state, topic, keyword and approval or effective date. Returns transmittal number (e.g. FL-25-0015), state, summary, approval and effective dates, topic tags and the approval-package link, newest approval first by default. Use for "which SPAs changed FQHC reimbursement in Florida". Unknown state or topic returns the valid values. Then call spa_get for the document text.

state.description: State name or 2-letter code (e.g. "Florida" or "FL"). Several can be given separated by "|".

topic.description: The publisher's topic tag (e.g. "Reimbursement", "Managed Care"). Unknown tags return near matches.

q.description: Keywords matched against the amendment text and summary, or a transmittal number.

approval_from.description: Earliest approval date, YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY.

page.description: Zero-based page number (default 0). Use total_pages / has_next from the response.

name: spa_get
description: Get one Medicaid State Plan Amendment by transmittal number (e.g. FL-25-0015, OH-22-0017): CMS Medicaid.gov metadata (state, summary, approval and effective dates, topics) plus the text of the approval package, returned as a window -- offset and max_chars, default 8,000 characters -- never the whole package. Follow text_next_offset until text_has_more is false. Scanned packages with no text layer say so instead of returning empty text. Set include_text=false for metadata only.

transmittal_number.description: State code, two-digit year and sequence, e.g. "FL-25-0015".

offset.description: Character offset into the extracted text (default 0).

include_text.description: false returns metadata and the package link only.

name: waiver_search
description: Search the CMS Medicaid.gov State Waivers List: section 1115 demonstrations and 1915(b)/(c) waivers, by state, authority, status and date. Returns waiver id, title, state, authority, status and approval and effective dates. Authority values: 1115, 1915 (b1), 1915 (b2), 1915 (b3), 1915 (b4), 1915 (c). Status values: Approved, Disapproved, Expired, Pending, Terminated, Withdrawn. Then call waiver_get for expiration date and documents.

state.description: State name or 2-letter code. Several can be given separated by "|".

q.description: Keywords matched against the waiver title.

approval_from.description: Earliest approval date, YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY.

name: waiver_get
description: Get one Medicaid waiver or demonstration from the CMS Medicaid.gov State Waivers List by waiver_id (from waiver_search): state, authority, status, approval, effective and expiration dates, and the supporting documents (approved applications, waiver descriptions, amendments) with dates, links and file sizes.
